sentences.text:
Coram: Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Suvir Sehgal
Present:- None for the petitioner.
 Mr. Arun Luthra, Dag, Punjab for respondent No.1.
 None for respondent No.2.

1.  Instant petition has been filed under Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 seeking quashing of FIR No.146 dated 09.09.2018, registered for offences under Section 420 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 and Section 24 of the Emigration Act, 1983, at Police Station Bhargo Camp,
Jalandhar, Annexure P-1, along with all subsequent proceedings arising therefrom, on the basis of the compromise dated 06.08.2019, Annexure P-2, arrived at between the parties.
2.
Report has been received from the Trial Court to the effect that none of the parties have appeared for the recording of their statements.
3. Still further, State counsel, upon instructions, ASI, Daljinder Lal, submits that the petitioner has been declared as a proclaimed offender.
He has opposed the prayer made in the petition by submitting that an absconder is not entitled to any relief.
4. Matter was taken up in the pre-lunch session and was passed over as the petitioner was unrepresented.
A message was flashed on the electronic display board.
However, nobody has appeared to represent the petitioner.
5. It seems that the petitioner is not interested in pursuing the matter.
